courses.title: White Tiger Qigong Membership
courses.description: An online membership giving structured access to the school's core qigong systems, level by level, with live classes each week. There are three plans: Foundation, Transformation and Professional, and a free seven-day trial.

courses.title: Qigong Breathwork (Inner Alchemy) Mastery Course and Teacher Training
courses.description: An online breathwork track rooted in Daoist inner alchemy (Nei Dan), taught live by Tevia Feng with recorded masterclasses. It runs over four levels, from foundations to facilitator training and certification.

courses.title: Dragon Meridian Qigong Master Course and Teacher Training
courses.description: A 12-week online programme in dynamic meridian exercises, breathwork and kinetic-chain training, led by Tevia Feng. It follows the school's five levels (Body, Breath, Spirit, Prescription and Teacher Training), with certification at Level 5.

courses.title: 5 Element Qigong Mastery Course and Teacher Training
courses.description: An online course in the five animal-element forms of 5 Element Qigong, with deep stretching and breathing practice. It runs over five levels with training manuals and a private community, and Level 5 leads to teacher certification.

courses.title: 8 Trigram Qigong Mastery Course and Teacher Training
courses.description: An online course in the flowing, coiling movements of 8 Trigram Qigong, linked to the eight trigrams of the Bagua. It runs over five levels with manuals and a private community, ending in teacher certification.

courses.title: 5 Animal Qigong Teacher Training: The Autumn and Winter Roads (Vietnam)
courses.description: Five Animal Qigong is taught in person: 13 days with Tevia Feng at Alba Wellness Valley near Hue, learning the Autumn and Winter Road forms of Tiger, Deer, Monkey, Bear and Crane from Hua Tuo's tradition. Students can attend Levels 1 and 2 for personal practice, or add six weeks online to certify as instructors.

courses.title: 5 Force Fit Instructor Program
courses.description: A fitness-oriented instructor programme that brings qigong-based movement into gyms, Pilates and yoga studios. It covers four signature sequences built around strength, mobility and flexibility, with licensing to teach after assessment.

courses.title: Bagua Walking Retreat (Vietnam, 2026)
courses.description: A ten-day in-person retreat at Alba Wellness Valley near Hue, where Tevia Feng teaches the walking, circling layer of 8 Trigram practice. Numbers are capped at 25 so that he can correct each student himself.

courses.title: Ba Duan Jin Teacher Training: The 11 Brocades Immersion (Vietnam)
courses.description: Two weeks at Alba Wellness Valley learning the Eight Pieces of Brocade plus three monastic-lineage movements with Tevia Feng and the senior team. Students can join for one week, for Levels 1 and 2, or continue online through Level 5 to certify as instructors. Tuition only; rooms are booked with the resort.

courses.title: 5 Element Qigong Master Course and Teacher Training (Vietnam)
courses.description: A 13-day in-person immersion at Alba Wellness Valley in the five forms of 5 Element Qigong, with standing practice, breathing and meditation. Levels 1 and 2 are taught in Vietnam, and Levels 3 to 5 follow online for those who want to certify.

courses.title: Bagua Circle Walking Retreat (Vietnam, 2027)
courses.description: A ten-day in-person retreat at Alba Wellness Valley in Bagua circle walking, the moving layer of 8 Trigram practice, with spiral work through the hips, spine and fascia. It is capped at 25 practitioners and taught by Tevia Feng.

free_resources.title: Free 5-Day Qigong Challenge
free_resources.description: A free five-day introduction to qigong for beginners, with one short guided practice video sent each morning and five bonus practices to keep. Most sessions take 10 to 20 minutes and include seated options.

free_resources.title: White Tiger Qigong Podcast
free_resources.description: The school's podcast, with conversations and interviews featuring Tevia Feng on qigong history, medical qigong, fascia, breath and the path to becoming a qigong teacher. Episodes can be played or downloaded from the page.

Membership: three plans published in the shop JSON: Foundation $39/month or $390/year, Transformation $89/month, Professional $229/month (USD). Page offers a 7-day free trial.

Certification tracks: Breathwork, Dragon Meridian, Five Element and Eight Trigram link to the product pages that the Teacher Certification page links to; prices are each product's lowest variant (Level 1). 5 Force Fit linked to its product page (single price $549). The Dragon Meridian product page hit a rate limit (429) when opened directly; its price and description come from the site's public products JSON.

Five Animal: the Teacher Certification page says Five Animal Qigong is taught in person only, so its track offering is the Vietnam training (14 to 26 Feb 2028, Autumn and Winter Roads). I found no separate future-dated 'Summer' path. 'From $897' is the super early-bird tuition until 15 Oct 2027.

Vietnam retreats: entered dated since each has its own future dates. The 5 Element Vietnam immersion (Aug 2027) is included as a retreat separately from the online 5 Element track. 'From' prices are early-bird or lowest-option tuition; accommodation is booked separately with Alba. Left out: Vietnam 8 Trigram (17 to 29 Aug 2026, already past).

5-Day Challenge: free, but you sign up with your email address and the videos arrive by email (acceptable for a challenge sign-up page). Its page markets days on eye strain, pain and anxiety; those claims are kept out of the description. resource_type set to mini_course.

Podcast: resource_type 'workshop' because the allowed list has no podcast type ('practice' would be wrong). Some older episode titles on the page carry health framing (depression, spinal health); the description avoids them.

Left out: condition-named shop courses (back pain, neck pain, depression, anxiety, sleep, cancer, pregnancy, etc.), standalone non-certification courses, merchandise, and the Prescription System (goes on Tevia Feng).
Unverified claims on the site (Harvard/Stanford/Cirque du Soleil collaboration, Bhutan monastery authorisation) are not repeated in any description.
